blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu caught fire in the fifth set to complete Farm Fresh’s reverse sweep of Choco Mucho, 20-25, 26-28, 25-23, 25-23, 15-13, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Conference on Thursday night at Mall of Asia Arena. Tubu scored seven of her 14 points to complete the Foxies’ fightback from two sets down as they forced a tie with the Flying Titans with a 2-1 record . “I took responsibility for every ball because every set I received was an opportunity to score a point.
